items.text: Minnesota (final report): OUT - QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), LB Blake Cashman (concussion), TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest), DT Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins (ankle), WR Jauan Jennings (calf). items.text: Green Bay (final report + Sat moves): OUT - RB Josh Jacobs (finger, surgery), EDGE Micah Parsons (knee/illness), C Sean Rhyan (ankle), TE Josh Whyle (concussion). DOUBTFUL - LB Zaire Franklin (shin). Jordan Love starts.
